verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms that Runpod serves an OpenAPI spec for its REST API v1 at https://rest.runpod.io/v1/openapi.json without authentication. That spec covers the documented REST API, which provides programmatic access to all compute resources. The 404s on docs.runpod.io candidate paths only show the spec is not hosted on the docs domain; they do not contradict it. missing for 10: first-party docs advertising where to download the spec, evidence of a machine-readable schema for the GraphQL API, independent community corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: https://rest.runpod.io/v1/openapi.json serves the REST API's OpenAPI spec keylessly
The Runpod REST API v1 provides programmatic access to all Runpod compute resources.
